newsitem.title: USA: Fed seen refraining from open market operations.
newsitem.headline: Fed seen refraining from open market operations.

text.p: The Federal Reserve is apt to refrain from open market operations on Friday, analysts said.
"We expect the Fed to stay sidelined," said Kim Rupert, senior economist at MMS International.
Federal funds were trading at a soft 5-1/8 percent, below the Fed's 5-1/4 percent target, in early trade.

Analysts noted that the Fed added temporary reserves to the banking system on Wednesday through eight-day fixed system repurchase agreements. That did not keep the Fed from adding reserves to the banking system through $1.5 billion in customer repurchase agreements on Thursday, however.
